title: Black Hole Lab — Training Budget Explorer
metric: Mean normalized RMSE on five held-out test rays (lower is better)

ppo.source: 1-minute PPO per-ray test CSV; normalized RMSE recomputed from U_SCALE=0.5 and V_SCALE=0.2

ppo.method: power-law extrapolation from the 1-minute and 10-minute PPO points
power-law extrapolation from the 1-minute and 10-minute PPO points
power-law extrapolation from the 1-minute and 10-minute PPO points

caveats: Only the 1-minute and 10-minute PPO points are measured. The 1-minute and 10-minute runs used different reward functions and PPO hyperparameters, so the fitted trend is a scenario, not a controlled learning curve.

The 1-minute MLP point is the existing 68.1-second MLP run, evaluated on the same five-ray test set. Its training log shows early stopping at epoch 160, with best validation rollout score at epoch 130. Longer MLP budgets are shown as a plateau assumption, not as additional training results.
The 1-hour, 10-hour and 10-day values are extrapolations only. They are not trained checkpoints, measured accuracy, or guarantees.
The test set contains five held-out rays. These results should be described as a small experiment, not broad evidence of generalization.
